preregistration.intent: The lab evaluation cannot be computed until bias60-external-lab-build delivers an artifact set, and that build is a multi-gigabyte retrieval over ten sources. Two cheap public measurements decide whether that build can succeed at all: whether each registered source answers an anonymous request today, and whether the frozen spec-4.1 exclusion (every official GEOID, every template GEOID and an 8 km neighbour buffer around every study tract) leaves enough candidate tracts in the planned state groups. Both are measured here on public Census tract geography only. This probe downloads no removed reference layer, reads no content byte from a source it only probes, and uses no credential.
preregistration.operator_decision_reference: operator decision 2026-10-25 09:35Z, recorded in orchestrator commit 901d5e3c8ee89eb9995e2adb15a3fee6c48b49ee: the external lab may be built; no reference layer or equivalent copy is ever computed on, joined to, or used to approximate targets for any study-region tract or GEOID
preregistration.title: Measure the preconditions of the external lab before the lab build spends its bandwidth: are the registered sources reachable, and do the planned lab groups still have tracts after the study exclusion runs on real census geography?
